description:
About the role

Northwind Labs is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead development of our analytics dashboard.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain React + TypeScript applications
- Partner with design on a shared component library
- Improve performance and accessibility across the product

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of frontend experience
- Deep knowledge of React, TypeScript, and modern CSS
- Experience with data visualization is a plus

Contoso is hiring a Full Stack Developer to work across our Python services and web client.

Responsibilities
- Design REST APIs in Flask
- Ship features end to end in a Next.js frontend
- Write tests and participate in code review

Requirements
- 3+ years building web applications
- Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
- Familiarity with SQL databases

Join Fabrikam's platform team to build the internal tools that power hundreds of engineers.

You will
- Own CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
- Improve build times and reliability

You have
- Strong fundamentals in at least one systems or scripting language
- Experience with cloud infrastructure
